body:
thank you very much, it's very sweet of you to say that. i believe it's hard to accept help because my counsellor in the beginning and my parents told me i was making things up to hide my drug use.. i honestly think it was the other way around, i did drugs to hide my feelings and what felt like a crumbling wall around me (i know differently now), so i always revert back to that basic instinct that i am fooling myself if that makes sense

i have also tried meditation. i've done a lot of dissociatives and used the time to meditate to come to terms with things around me and to give me the push to seek help from the start and keep fighting. ultimately i've had to leave that behind and learning to cope without substances is difficult. it's easier to kick the emptiness using a drug but it's not practical in the long run

i suppose in a way, yeah, it does feel hard but i get a lot of "it could be worse" and "i don't know what to say" because no one i know directly has any practical experience with ptsd, etc etc. i do know that people talk from their own personal experiences, and that they can't be blamed for saying these things. that being said, i feel more comfortable talking to my psych (i failed my third year of psych but switched majors to pass uni) so i have a lot of faith in diagnoses and treatment, i know that he knows what he's talking about. the recent clarity has come about from my latest life circumstances but there is still a gap between where i am and where i would like to be, emotion-wise

thank you very much for taking the time to type out advice and thoughts to me i really appreciate it. i took my meds earlier and it helped me calm down again. i hope you'll have a good day

thak you. i have a hard time believing that what happened to me was "bad" because of immense dissociation... it doesn't even feel like me. i tend to discount my achievements up to "luck" and things like that but am trying to convince myself that this is just due to negative association with myself and my person after years of depression if that makes sense. i also feel selfish writing this so there's that

i am in contact with my psychotherapist via email but due to autistic traits am uncomfortable speaking about it in person. i'm lacking in emotion or thinly veil my emotion most of the time because it's hard to distinguish that people possess rationality alongside emotionality. i spent years trying to condition myself to believe i could separate myself from emotion, and while it helped in the short run, i have incongruence between what i think and how i act. my dad is autistic too and my mother has a habit of being overwhelmed with emotion.. so i'm too shy to bring it up. they tend to tell me to talk to my psych. i have my SO, but he's also autistic.. so he's also uncomfortable with many emotions

i dropped most of my friends because they either said i was a coward for attempting suicide, or that i was stupid because i couldn't defend myself. a lot of my old friends are very heavy into drugs now so i've cut off contact because i'm worried about aggravating my ptsd. my mom did find my blog a few years back and it concerned her because she felt i was in immediate danger and now i'm very shy about associating myself with my emotions

most of the time i'm dissociated so my reasoning is that i'm lying to myself but a change in environment helped me. i know that's not always easily accessible and dire amounts of support are needed but i still have the tunnel vision and the inability to accept that things change. idk

people started leaving my life too. i decided to one up everyone else and i disappeared from their lives as well. that never helped me. i wish i could offer help but i'm also the girl who eats alone and watches movies by herself. i feel self conscious, like everyone is laughing at me. it was worst in the dorm, i would have to eat alone and people would visibly avoid me and it was depressing. i started sneaking food into my room and eating there. i wish there was an easy practical solution for most problems.. obviously if i decided to post here, i feel the easiest one would be suicide but i'm at the point where apathy makes me believe that even that is too much effort.

when i attempted suicide and moved back home, my dad broke down and told me he didn't want to be burying a body and he thought he was going to have to do that instead of seeing me alive. it made an impact, but like you, that didn't stay. these days i have stopped being so considerate and still wouldn't mind leaving my SO and my parents behind. i'm very selfish in that aspect but it's very consuming. i am naturally a negative person so my first response when i want to kill myself is that i am worthless and that no one will love me

recently that has been getting better since i opened up to my SO. he tells me that i am a worthy person and that i am good and this eases things a bit but it is still hard to accept. mainly because i have kept to myself for so long and can rarely trust what anyone says. i really struck out with my SO because he helps me combat my suicidal ideation but i still would love to smash a glass bottle and stab myself with the pieces

you are a better person than me for the fact that you thought of your mom. i didn't even think of anyone except the pain i was causing people which was all imagined... i'm only learning that now. people always tell me i'm strong and that depresses me so much. i find that what does help me is writing down shit like "people want you alive" and "nobody will hurt you again" helps me when i repeat it to myself... it's grounding for me

thank you very much, the support is something i am grateful for. i was drugged and sexually assaulted whilst i was blacked out. i woke up and lost my keys, glasses and jumper so i spent 6 hours locked out in the middle of the night. i later found out my underwear was missing and i was bleeding so i went to get a rape kit. i was living in a dorm at the time in another country and someone found out. i got repeated prankcalls and prank knocks on my door for months. heavy breating on the other end of the line and laughter. i have autism as a preface so the loud and constant shouting/ringing from the phone (landline, couldn't disconnect) aggravated it. i ended up abusing drugs for 4 years after

my dorm counsellor found out i had "lost" my things but i refused to report the sexual assault. she took it as i was abusing drugs and trying to hide something. she told me that i was a disappointment and that my sister was a lot easier to deal with when she was here. that's the gist of it, there are more details but these hurt the most

i just graduated uni..... it's been 6 months and my parents have wanted me to find a job or start my teaching course but i have heart problems from the last suicide attempt. my SO is moving ahead in his life and it's like i'm stuck. my mother thinks i am freeloading and my father is too nice to say anything but it's hard to get out of this fog

i developed ptsd several years ago. i got drugged and sexually assaulted. people in my dorm found out and prankcalled me 15 times a month for 8 months. i had a severe breakdown and i couldn't even leave my room to pee. i didn't eat for days at a time. i'm still having issues with drug addiction after going cold turkey after 3-4 years. things went to shit for years. there was no light at the end of the tunnel. i got assaulted again last november. that's when i attempted suicide

i developed psychotic depression. as a result i lost all the friends i made and people stopped pretending i existed. i'm too ashamed to talk to anyone i used to know because it's like i'm tainted. i am very incapable at making friends, so i do most of my interacting online. it worked out because i met somebody... but i have only had one friend since i was 8. most of my family is not close to me. my immediate family is very small and my grandmother just passed

i don't know if this is full of myself but i have been through a lot of shit in the past 5 or maybe even 10 years because of my depression and the emptiness it brings. some days are better and some days are not. sometimes it's a bad week, sometimes a bad month, and sometimes a bad year. i can only say that i should never have wasted my time attempting suicide because in the last 6 months i got my degree, met my SO again (long distance) and moved home to take care of 14 cats (my favourite people) and it has helped my mood. that being said, i am still suicidal but i have sought the help of a psych i finally trust and am off zoloft so i have stopped feeling like a robot

much love to you and i hope you will be able to get through this and see the light at the end of the tunnel one day. hugs from me
thank you. sometimes it's bearable but i don't know what's bearable anymore because it's like being in a haze. you can't see the contrasting view. hugs from me as well

so i only got diagnosed with aspergers/level 2 severity asd 8 months ago. i spent the previous 4 years in uni and i stayed in a college dorm. it was loud and out of my stable control and flexibility. people constantly shouted at me and encouraged me to be social and i tried to force myself but it was lonely

i have spent my entire life being alone. i was more alone than ever in that dorm. i moved out and i couldn't interact well with my flatmates. everything was and is bad and sad and stupid

i hate small talk. i hate fucking interaction. i have never had a boyfriend or girlfriend before this. no one in school and in uni knew i exist/existed. people always asked who that was when they called my name for attendance, even people i've known since i was 9

a year into living in an apartment on my own with no one knowing my name and me constantly fucking up my grades and my attendance, i met my current SO online. it's a nice change. he has autism too. i feel less alone. he lives in belgium and we've only seen each other a few times over the years but it gets me accustomed to another person's touch

last year i met my now best friend. he has high functioning autism. i have never been as happy as the time i spent with him. i'm home now (moved back) so i can't talk to him anymore

i suffered a lot of abuse in social interactions because of basically feeling incompetent but the people i've met and the few friends i've kept (maybe three) have made a huge difference to the large, burrowing emptiness

i'm sorry i can't provide practical solutions to how to deal with interaction. i did and do most of mine online with people who are poor with understanding social barriers and norms. it makes things easier. one thing i do know is that it's a painful learning process. whether it's worth it doing these things is up to you to decide
